verdicts.reason: Both use the same scattered layout. The 'Sunset Sessions' headline sits on the sun circle. The tagline is pushed into a narrow left column. RSVP is boxed into a right column next to the date. The FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills are stacked with large uneven gaps and pulled away from the event details. The bottom-left is mostly empty apart from the can. Reading order runs brand → tagline → date → CTA → pills, which is jumbled. B is worse because its time/location line is shrunk to tiny type that runs almost into the RSVP column. A keeps that line at a readable size with a clean two-line wrap.
